intro.h2: A kitchen built around what you asked for
paragraphs: Florida Cabinet Solutions Co. does kitchen remodeling in Homestead, and its reviews read like thank-you notes. One customer said Mr. Alejandro listened to what he and his wife wanted in the kitchen, then helped them through the whole remodel. Their kitchen got a custom vent hood he calls amazing, and the work finished on time.

On Facebook, the company describes itself as custom high-end kitchen design and remodeling, working with all kinds of kitchens from Italian to classical designs. Reviewers add the practical side: detailed work, affordable and reasonable prices, and Alex Silva, who one family says had excellent ideas. That family now calls itself customers for life. The company is open every day of the week.

services.h2: Custom kitchen remodeling in Homestead and more

items.name: Custom kitchen design and remodeling
items.blurb: Full kitchen remodels designed around your taste and your space, from sleek Italian-style flat panels to classical designs. Reviewers say the team listened to what they wanted, shared excellent ideas and helped them through each step of the remodel.

image.alt: Bright kitchen with white flat-panel cabinets, a wood-tone peninsula with black bar stools and white quartz-look counters

items.name: Custom cabinets
items.blurb: Cabinets are in the name. Their photos show tall white flat-panel pantry cabinets with matte black pulls, built in around a stainless refrigerator and microwave. Talk through the layout and finish with the team so the storage fits the way you cook.

image.alt: Wall of tall white flat-panel cabinets with black pulls around a stainless French-door refrigerator

items.name: Custom vent hoods
items.blurb: A range hood can be the centerpiece of a kitchen. One reviewer called the custom vent hood in their new kitchen amazing. The one shown here has a smooth white body and a white oak band, flanked by matching floating oak shelves.

image.alt: Custom white range hood with a white oak band between floating oak shelves

items.name: Islands and countertops
items.blurb: Islands get special attention. Their photos include a white waterfall island where the countertop runs down the side to the floor, and a peninsula with a wood-tone base and bar seating. Countertops are part of the kitchen job, chosen to match your cabinets.

image.alt: White waterfall countertop with an undermount sink and black faucet next to white cabinets

items.name: Bathroom vanities with quartz tops
items.blurb: Not just kitchens. One customer had five bathroom vanities installed with quartz tops and said the job came out beautiful, then planned to use the team for the kitchen next. A single vanity or a whole house of them can be planned together.

image.alt: White shaker bathroom vanity with a quartz top, undermount sink and brushed nickel faucet below a round gold-framed mirror

about.text: Florida Cabinet Solutions Co. is a kitchen remodeler on SW 336th St in Homestead, Florida, listed on Facebook as Florida Cabinet Solutions Inc. The company focuses on custom high-end kitchen design and remodeling and works with all kinds of kitchens, ranging from Italian to classical designs. Customers name Alex Silva and Mr. Alejandro as the people who listened to their ideas and guided the remodel. Besides full kitchens, the team builds custom vent hoods and installs bathroom vanities with quartz tops. Every review on Google gives five stars.
about.owner_role: Named in a review as the person who helped with ideas; a second review names 'Mr. Alejandro' (possibly the same person). Ownership and title not published.

service_area.text: Florida Cabinet Solutions Co. works from 20951 SW 336th St, Homestead, FL 33034. Homestead is the town on its Google profile and the town tied to its Facebook project photos. If you are planning a kitchen remodel, new cabinets or bathroom vanities in or near Homestead, call (786) 253-4556 any day of the week to ask whether your home is in their area.

items.q: What styles of kitchen do you build?
items.a: Their Facebook page says they work with all kinds of kitchens, ranging from Italian to classical designs. Their photos show sleek white flat-panel kitchens with black hardware, white oak shelves and a custom hood, plus a waterfall island and a wood-tone peninsula. Bring photos of styles you like.

items.q: Can you build a custom range hood?
items.a: Yes. A Google reviewer said the custom vent hood in their new kitchen was amazing. The hood in their photos has a smooth white body with a white oak band at the bottom, matched to floating oak shelves on either side. Ask about shapes and finishes when you call.

Yes, bathroom vanities. One customer had five bathroom vanities installed with quartz tops and said the job came out beautiful. If you are updating several bathrooms, or a bathroom and the kitchen together, the team can plan the cabinets and tops for all of them.

Google lists Florida Cabinet Solutions Co. as open every day, Sunday through Saturday, from 8 AM to 8 PM. Call (786) 253-4556 during those hours or email flcabinetsolutions@gmail.com with photos and measurements of your kitchen to get the conversation started.

items.q: How long does a kitchen remodel take, and what does it cost?
items.a: Both depend on the size of your kitchen and what you choose, so the team works it out with you during design. One reviewer says the team finished the work on time and calls the prices very affordable and reasonable. Call to talk through your project and get a quote.

final_cta.text: Call Florida Cabinet Solutions any day from 8 AM to 8 PM.
